description:
This plugin provides a CSV import of organizations of one organization type for your Memority tenant.

        It configures a CSV connector, an application, an import synchronization task and its post-processing (archive, error report, notification).

        Use it on a tenant project that you initialized with the **Initialize project** action of MIT.

        Please refer to the [documentation](https://doc.memority.eu/setup-guide/latest/organization-import-by-csv-file-plugin) before use.
